headline: Gameweek 12 is the next deadline, and this creator's videos are about transfers, captains and a goalkeeper buy.

points.text: Your 15-minute window: one creator's videos cover Gameweek 12 team news, transfers and captain picks. Most are sponsored, and each one ends with an ad link.
points.label: reported

points.text: The creator says it's time to buy a goalkeeper. Their Gameweek 12 team video is one take, not a rule.
points.label: opinion

points.text: The creator suggests selling Mbeumo and buying Kinsky. They frame these as questions, not firm calls.
points.label: opinion

points.text: The creator says Haaland is not their captain pick. Another video asks whether Wirtz is essential.
points.label: opinion

points.text: The creator's last season finished 588th. Their best ranks listed are 588 and 1294, so results vary.
points.label: reported

differences.text: Sources give different transfer ideas, such as buying Kinsky or a goalkeeper, and selling Mbeumo or keeping Wirtz. Pick the one that fits your team.
